title: Agenti, alati i MCP
summary: Agent pretvara grešku modela u akciju: OWASP LLM06 Excessive Agency i Top 10 za agentne aplikacije, policy gateway sa allowlistom i JSON Schema validacijom, čovjek u petlji, sigurnost MCP-a i limiti protiv neograničene potrošnje (LLM10).
summary_en: An agent turns a model error into an action: OWASP LLM06 Excessive Agency and the Top 10 for Agentic Applications, a policy gateway with an allowlist and JSON Schema validation, human-in-the-loop, MCP security and limits against unbounded consumption (LLM10).
